name: mainnet
notes: BLANK FORM, NOT A PLAN. Copy to config/deployments/56/<name>.plan.json, fill in every null with a value verified against BSC mainnet on the day, and delete the "template" flag; "name" must equal <name>. Nothing here is invented: the VRF coordinator, the key hash, the feed proxies and the token addresses are operator inputs (SPEC section 14: the operator supplies actual chain/token/feed configuration). Both scripts/validate_config.ts and DeploymentLib.readDocument refuse a document while "template" is true. The chain facts below are the ones already recorded in config/chains/56.json. Mainnet-only rules the validator enforces on this document: three distinct Safes with deployed code in ownership (O2/O4), nonzero makeWholeReserve and makeWholeCap, observedP999IntervalSeconds and observationWindow measured with scripts/observe_feed.ts, a non-null heartbeatSeconds, and status "approved" for every asset. See docs/runbooks/mainnet-launch.md.

maxRequestCostDerivation.note: Record the lane's documented maximum gas price, the coordinator's verification overhead and the premium, each verified against the deployed coordinator on the day of the deployment (SPEC section 7.1).

ownership.note: SPEC section 10.5: three separate Safes (owner, treasury/fee account, seed account) with 2-of-3 independently generated hardware keys, the recovery drill performed on these Safes before Deploy and recorded under custody.recoveryDrill in the release-authority record, and the make-whole reserve actually held in the treasury Safe. The final owner must accept both Ownable2Step transfers, and the seed account must call Vault.authorizeSeed itself before any seed entry.

assets.exactTransferEvidence: Native path: the Vault credits exactly msg.value and checks the exact debit on withdrawal, so no token transfer hook can change the amount (SPEC section 3.1).
